blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the point of intersection of the coordinate axes and the following linear functions graphically: \(y = -5x + 10\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh intercepts ka sawal hai: seedhi line x-axis aur y-axis ko kahan kaat-ti hai (cross karti hai)?
Yaad rakhiye: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par har point ka \(y = 0\). Bas yahi do baatein is sawal ki chaabi hain.
Plan: pehle substitution se dono crossing points nikaalenge, phir chhoti si table banayenge, graph par line kheenchenge aur graph se dono points parh kar tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: linear function \(y = -5x + 10\) (slope \(-5\), constant term \(10\)).
Humein find karna hai: woh points jahan is ki line x-axis aur y-axis se milti hai.
Tareeqa: y-intercept ke liye \(x = 0\) rakhenge aur x-intercept ke liye \(y = 0\). Phir table bana kar graph kheenchenge aur graph se crossing points parhenge. Algebra hamein bata deta hai ke graph par kahan dekhna hai, aur graph is baat ki tasdeeq karta hai.

y-intercept nikaalein (\(x = 0\) rakhein)
\[y = -5(0) + 10\]
\[y = 10\]
Line y-axis ko \((0,\ 10)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: y-axis woh khari line hai jahan har point ka x-coordinate zero hota hai. Is liye jo point line par bhi ho aur y-axis par bhi, us ka \(x\) lazmi 0 hoga. Asaan tareeqa yaad rakhiye: \(y = mx + c\) mein y-intercept hamesha \((0, c)\) hota hai.

x-intercept nikaalein (\(y = 0\) rakhein)
\[0 = -5x + 10\]
\[5x = 10\]
\[x = 2\]
Line x-axis ko \((2,\ 0)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: x-axis par har point ka y-coordinate zero hota hai, is liye \(y = 0\) rakh kar equation ko \(x\) ke liye solve kiya. Dono taraf \(5x\) jama kiya taa ke \(x\) wala term akela ek taraf aa jaye, phir 5 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: bohat se students constant term ko hi x-intercept likh dete hain. Constant term sirf y-intercept deta hai; x-intercept ke liye equation solve karni parti hai.

Table of values banayein (\(x = 0, 1, 2, 3\))
\[x = 1:\ y = -5 + 10 = 5\]
\[x = 3:\ y = -15 + 10 = -5\]
Points: \((0, 10),\ (1, 5),\ (2, 0),\ (3, -5)\).
Kyun: seedhi line ke liye do points kaafi hote hain, lekin teesra aur chautha point check ka kaam karta hai: agar koi point line se hat jaye to samajh jayein ke hisaab mein ghalti hai. Slope \(-5\) ka matlab: har 1 qadam right jaane par line 5 qadam neeche aati hai, is liye yeh tez girti hui (steep falling) line hai.

Graph banayein
Table ke points graph paper par lagayein, ruler se jor dein aur line ko dono taraf aage tak barha dein.
Line y-axis ko \((0,\ 10)\) par aur x-axis ko \((2,\ 0)\) par kaat-ti hai.
Kyun: sawal mein "graphically" likha hai, yani jawab graph se parh kar dena hai. Line left se right ki taraf neeche girti hai, kyunke slope negative hai. Step 2 aur 3 ka algebra pehle se bata deta hai ke crossing kahan honi chahiye, is liye graph parhna aasaan aur pakka ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{slope} = \dfrac{0 - 10}{2 - 0}\]
\[= \dfrac{-10}{2} = -5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono intercepts ke darmiyan slope wohi hona chahiye jo equation mein \(x\) ka coefficient hai. Agar barabar aa jaye to dono points waqai isi line par hain aur hamara jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Line x-axis ko \((2,\ 0)\) par aur y-axis ko \((0,\ 10)\) par kaat-ti hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of the falling line y = -5x + 10 through (1, 5) and (3, -5), crossing the y-axis at (0, 10) and the x-axis at (2, 0).
answer_figure.caption: Question 1 (i): the line and its two intercepts (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the point of intersection of the coordinate axes and the following linear functions graphically: \(y = 2x - 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh intercepts ka sawal hai: seedhi line x-axis aur y-axis ko kahan kaat-ti hai (cross karti hai)?
Yaad rakhiye: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par har point ka \(y = 0\). Bas yahi do baatein is sawal ki chaabi hain.
Plan: pehle substitution se dono crossing points nikaalenge, phir chhoti si table banayenge, graph par line kheenchenge aur graph se dono points parh kar tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: linear function \(y = 2x - 1\) (slope \(2\), constant term \(-1\)).
Humein find karna hai: woh points jahan is ki line x-axis aur y-axis se milti hai.
Tareeqa: y-intercept ke liye \(x = 0\) rakhenge aur x-intercept ke liye \(y = 0\). Phir table bana kar graph kheenchenge aur graph se crossing points parhenge. Algebra hamein bata deta hai ke graph par kahan dekhna hai, aur graph is baat ki tasdeeq karta hai.

y-intercept nikaalein (\(x = 0\) rakhein)
\[y = 2(0) - 1\]
\[y = -1\]
Line y-axis ko \((0,\ -1)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: y-axis woh khari line hai jahan har point ka x-coordinate zero hota hai. Is liye jo point line par bhi ho aur y-axis par bhi, us ka \(x\) lazmi 0 hoga. Asaan tareeqa yaad rakhiye: \(y = mx + c\) mein y-intercept hamesha \((0, c)\) hota hai.

x-intercept nikaalein (\(y = 0\) rakhein)
\[0 = 2x - 1\]
\[2x = 1\]
\[x = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Line x-axis ko \(\left(\tfrac{1}{2},\ 0\right)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: x-axis par har point ka y-coordinate zero hota hai, is liye \(y = 0\) rakh kar equation ko \(x\) ke liye solve kiya. Dono taraf 1 jama kiya aur phir 2 se divide kiya, taa ke \(x\) akela reh jaye.
Dhyan dein: bohat se students constant term ko hi x-intercept likh dete hain. Constant term sirf y-intercept deta hai; x-intercept ke liye equation solve karni parti hai.

Table of values banayein (\(x = -1, 0, 1, 2\))
\[x = -1:\ y = -2 - 1 = -3\]
\[x = 1:\ y = 2 - 1 = 1\]
\[x = 2:\ y = 4 - 1 = 3\]
Points: \((-1, -3),\ (0, -1),\ (1, 1),\ (2, 3)\).
Kyun: seedhi line ke liye do points kaafi hote hain, lekin teesra aur chautha point check ka kaam karta hai: agar koi point line se hat jaye to samajh jayein ke hisaab mein ghalti hai. x-intercept \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) fraction hai, is liye graph par isay 0 aur 1 ke bilkul beech mein lagayein; aadhe square ka andaza dhyan se lagayein.

Graph banayein
Table ke points graph paper par lagayein, ruler se jor dein aur line ko dono taraf aage tak barha dein.
Line y-axis ko \((0,\ -1)\) par aur x-axis ko \(\left(\tfrac{1}{2},\ 0\right)\) par kaat-ti hai.
Kyun: sawal mein "graphically" likha hai, yani jawab graph se parh kar dena hai. Line left se right ki taraf upar charhti hai, kyunke slope positive (2) hai. Step 2 aur 3 ka algebra pehle se bata deta hai ke crossing kahan honi chahiye, is liye graph parhna aasaan aur pakka ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{slope} = \dfrac{0 - (-1)}{\tfrac{1}{2} - 0}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{1/2} = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono intercepts ke darmiyan slope wohi hona chahiye jo equation mein \(x\) ka coefficient hai. Agar barabar aa jaye to dono points waqai isi line par hain aur hamara jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Line x-axis ko \(\left(\tfrac{1}{2},\ 0\right)\) par aur y-axis ko \((0,\ -1)\) par kaat-ti hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of the rising line y = 2x - 1 through (-1, -3), (1, 1) and (2, 3), crossing the y-axis at (0, -1) and the x-axis at (1/2, 0).
answer_figure.caption: Question 1 (ii): the line and its two intercepts (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the point of intersection of the coordinate axes and the following linear functions graphically: \(y = \dfrac{1}{2}x - 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh intercepts ka sawal hai: seedhi line x-axis aur y-axis ko kahan kaat-ti hai (cross karti hai)?
Yaad rakhiye: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par har point ka \(y = 0\). Bas yahi do baatein is sawal ki chaabi hain.
Plan: pehle substitution se dono crossing points nikaalenge, phir chhoti si table banayenge, graph par line kheenchenge aur graph se dono points parh kar tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: linear function \(y = \dfrac{1}{2}x - 3\) (slope \(\tfrac{1}{2}\), constant term \(-3\)).
Humein find karna hai: woh points jahan is ki line x-axis aur y-axis se milti hai.
Tareeqa: y-intercept ke liye \(x = 0\) rakhenge aur x-intercept ke liye \(y = 0\). Phir table bana kar graph kheenchenge aur graph se crossing points parhenge. Algebra hamein bata deta hai ke graph par kahan dekhna hai, aur graph is baat ki tasdeeq karta hai.

y-intercept nikaalein (\(x = 0\) rakhein)
\[y = \dfrac{1}{2}(0) - 3\]
\[y = -3\]
Line y-axis ko \((0,\ -3)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: y-axis woh khari line hai jahan har point ka x-coordinate zero hota hai. Is liye jo point line par bhi ho aur y-axis par bhi, us ka \(x\) lazmi 0 hoga. Asaan tareeqa yaad rakhiye: \(y = mx + c\) mein y-intercept hamesha \((0, c)\) hota hai.

x-intercept nikaalein (\(y = 0\) rakhein)
\[0 = \dfrac{1}{2}x - 3\]
\[\dfrac{1}{2}x = 3\]
\[x = 6\]
Line x-axis ko \((6,\ 0)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: x-axis par har point ka y-coordinate zero hota hai, is liye \(y = 0\) rakh kar equation ko \(x\) ke liye solve kiya. Dono taraf 3 jama kiya, phir dono taraf 2 se multiply kiya, kyunke \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) ko hatane ke liye us ke ulte (reciprocal) 2 se zarb dete hain.
Dhyan dein: bohat se students constant term ko hi x-intercept likh dete hain. Constant term sirf y-intercept deta hai; x-intercept ke liye equation solve karni parti hai.

Table of values banayein (even values \(x = -2, 0, 2, 4, 6\))
\[x = -2:\ y = -1 - 3 = -4\]
\[x = 2:\ y = 1 - 3 = -2\]
\[x = 4:\ y = 2 - 3 = -1\]
Points: \((-2, -4),\ (0, -3),\ (2, -2),\ (4, -1),\ (6, 0)\).
Kyun: seedhi line ke liye do points kaafi hote hain, lekin teesra aur chautha point check ka kaam karta hai: agar koi point line se hat jaye to samajh jayein ke hisaab mein ghalti hai. Hum ne jaan boojh kar even values li hain, taa ke \(\tfrac{1}{2}x\) poora number aaye aur points lagana aasaan ho; odd values se fractions aate aur ghalti ka imkaan barhta.

Graph banayein
Table ke points graph paper par lagayein, ruler se jor dein aur line ko dono taraf aage tak barha dein.
Line y-axis ko \((0,\ -3)\) par aur x-axis ko \((6,\ 0)\) par kaat-ti hai.
Kyun: sawal mein "graphically" likha hai, yani jawab graph se parh kar dena hai. Slope sirf \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) hai, is liye line aahista aahista upar charhti hai: 2 qadam right, 1 qadam upar. Step 2 aur 3 ka algebra pehle se bata deta hai ke crossing kahan honi chahiye, is liye graph parhna aasaan aur pakka ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{slope} = \dfrac{0 - (-3)}{6 - 0}\]
\[= \dfrac{3}{6} = \dfrac{1}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono intercepts ke darmiyan slope wohi hona chahiye jo equation mein \(x\) ka coefficient hai. Agar barabar aa jaye to dono points waqai isi line par hain aur hamara jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Line x-axis ko \((6,\ 0)\) par aur y-axis ko \((0,\ -3)\) par kaat-ti hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of the gently rising line y = (1/2)x - 3 through (-2, -4), (2, -2) and (4, -1), crossing the y-axis at (0, -3) and the x-axis at (6, 0).
answer_figure.caption: Question 1 (iii): the line and its two intercepts (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Find the point of intersection of the coordinate axes and the following linear functions graphically: \(y = 3x + \dfrac{3}{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh intercepts ka sawal hai: seedhi line x-axis aur y-axis ko kahan kaat-ti hai (cross karti hai)?
Yaad rakhiye: y-axis par har point ka \(x = 0\) hota hai, aur x-axis par har point ka \(y = 0\). Bas yahi do baatein is sawal ki chaabi hain.
Plan: pehle substitution se dono crossing points nikaalenge, phir chhoti si table banayenge, graph par line kheenchenge aur graph se dono points parh kar tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: linear function \(y = 3x + \dfrac{3}{2}\) (slope \(3\), constant term \(\tfrac{3}{2}\)).
Humein find karna hai: woh points jahan is ki line x-axis aur y-axis se milti hai.
Tareeqa: y-intercept ke liye \(x = 0\) rakhenge aur x-intercept ke liye \(y = 0\). Phir table bana kar graph kheenchenge aur graph se crossing points parhenge. Algebra hamein bata deta hai ke graph par kahan dekhna hai, aur graph is baat ki tasdeeq karta hai.

y-intercept nikaalein (\(x = 0\) rakhein)
\[y = 3(0) + \dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[y = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
Line y-axis ko \(\left(0,\ \tfrac{3}{2}\right)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: y-axis woh khari line hai jahan har point ka x-coordinate zero hota hai. Is liye jo point line par bhi ho aur y-axis par bhi, us ka \(x\) lazmi 0 hoga. Asaan tareeqa yaad rakhiye: \(y = mx + c\) mein y-intercept hamesha \((0, c)\) hota hai.

x-intercept nikaalein (\(y = 0\) rakhein)
\[0 = 3x + \dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[3x = -\dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[x = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Line x-axis ko \(\left(-\tfrac{1}{2},\ 0\right)\) par milti hai.
Kyun: x-axis par har point ka y-coordinate zero hota hai, is liye \(y = 0\) rakh kar equation ko \(x\) ke liye solve kiya. Dono taraf se \(\tfrac{3}{2}\) minus kiya aur phir 3 se divide kiya: \(-\tfrac{3}{2} \div 3 = -\tfrac{1}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: bohat se students constant term ko hi x-intercept likh dete hain. Constant term sirf y-intercept deta hai; x-intercept ke liye equation solve karni parti hai.

Table of values banayein (\(x = -1, 0, 1\))
\[x = -1:\ y = -3 + \tfrac{3}{2} = -\tfrac{3}{2}\]
\[x = 1:\ y = 3 + \tfrac{3}{2} = \tfrac{9}{2}\]
Points: \((-1, -1.5),\ (0, 1.5),\ (1, 4.5)\).
Kyun: seedhi line ke liye do points kaafi hote hain, lekin teesra aur chautha point check ka kaam karta hai: agar koi point line se hat jaye to samajh jayein ke hisaab mein ghalti hai. Fractions ko decimal mein likhna (\(\tfrac{3}{2} = 1.5\), \(\tfrac{9}{2} = 4.5\)) graph par point lagane mein madad karta hai.

Graph banayein
Table ke points graph paper par lagayein, ruler se jor dein aur line ko dono taraf aage tak barha dein.
Line y-axis ko \(\left(0,\ \tfrac{3}{2}\right)\) par aur x-axis ko \(\left(-\tfrac{1}{2},\ 0\right)\) par kaat-ti hai.
Kyun: sawal mein "graphically" likha hai, yani jawab graph se parh kar dena hai. Slope 3 hai, is liye line tez charhti hai, aur x-axis ko origin ke left mein, \(-\tfrac{1}{2}\) par kaat-ti hai. Step 2 aur 3 ka algebra pehle se bata deta hai ke crossing kahan honi chahiye, is liye graph parhna aasaan aur pakka ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{slope} = \dfrac{\tfrac{3}{2} - 0}{0 - (-\tfrac{1}{2})}\]
\[= \dfrac{3/2}{1/2} = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: dono intercepts ke darmiyan slope wohi hona chahiye jo equation mein \(x\) ka coefficient hai. Agar barabar aa jaye to dono points waqai isi line par hain aur hamara jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: Line x-axis ko \(\left(-\tfrac{1}{2},\ 0\right)\) par aur y-axis ko \(\left(0,\ \tfrac{3}{2}\right)\) par kaat-ti hai.
